title: Which phone should I buy?
instructions: Deniz mağazada iki telefonu karşılaştırıyor. Hangi özelliğin hangi telefona ait olduğunu karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: deniz
script.text: Hi. I can't decide between these two phones. What's the difference?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: The Nova is cheaper, only two hundred and fifty pounds. The Star is four hundred.

script.speaker: deniz
script.text: Why is the Star more expensive?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: It has a better camera, and the screen is bigger.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Actually, the Nova's battery is better. It lasts two days. The Star lasts only one day.

script.speaker: deniz
script.text: I don't take many photos, but I travel a lot for work.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Then I think the Nova is better for you.

script.speaker: deniz
script.text: You're right. I'll take the Nova in grey, please.

questions.feedback: Star dört yüz pound; Nova iki yüz elli.

questions.prompt: What is better on the Star?
questions.feedback: Star'ın kamerası daha iyi, ekranı daha büyük.
questions.evidence: It has a better camera, and the screen is bigger.

questions.prompt: How long does the Nova's battery last?
questions.feedback: Nova'nın pili iki gün dayanıyor; Star'ınki bir gün.

questions.prompt: Why does Deniz choose the Nova?
options: She takes a lot of photos.
questions.feedback: Çok fotoğraf çekmiyor ama iş için çok seyahat ediyor; uzun pil önemli.
questions.evidence: but I travel a lot for work.

questions.prompt: What colour phone does Deniz buy?
questions.evidence: I'll take the Nova in grey, please.
